mechanism: Separate the first source digit into red handed vertical strokes and blue horizontal completion bars. Intended error: combine upper bars without reflecting their top/bottom positions, reading 2:6:9 instead of 5:6:9.
primary_mathematical_proof: Fold across y=3 maps y to 6-y. First source upper-right bar (x=1,y4.5..5.5) becomes lower-right y0.5..1.5; lower-left bar (x=0,y3.5..4.5) becomes upper-left y1.5..2.5. With three fixed bottom horizontal bars this is 5. The middle digit becomes 6 and right becomes 9, hence C uniquely. Dots separating digits and marking unused endpoints stay unchanged. Color/width do not add or remove any number-encoding segment.

marker_roles.role: The two input handed vertical features of the first numeral; their upper/lower order must reverse in the real fold.

The three horizontal completion bars at exactly the first numeral position; blue groups the stationary half against the red source half. Every bar contributes to the target digit, without changing cut boundaries or numeric content.
